description: This file is a shell script containing functions for Buffalo router firmware upgrade and validation, especially for the MT7622 devices. It includes notes on device compatibility, upgrade procedures, and functions for image validation and upgrading via UBI methods.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for the Buffalo MT7622 devices, checking magic numbers, tar archive validity, partition sizes, and compatibility.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs an upgrade of the device firmware using a TRX + UBI formatted image, handling cache cleaning, partition detachment, erasing and writing to flash partitions.
